observations.behavior: Adds a specific permission class to the CustomPropertyDefinitionViewSet.
observations.posthog_connection: Restricts deletion and other write operations on account-scoped resources; tier 3 requires broader systemic change or critical-path coverage.

observations.behavior: Tests that an editor cannot delete while only having project-level access, whereas admin can.
observations.posthog_connection: Demonstrates enforcement of account-resource permissions rather than team-wide shared ownership; this is bounded by the viewset's scope_object="account". No wider system dependency shown.

observations.behavior: Changes the delete confirmation message in the frontend UI to warn about irreversible loss of stored values.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies user expectations for account-scoped resource cleanup without changing backend behavior or adding new capabilities.

observations.limitations: Only account-scoped custom property definitions are covered; no changes to group-type properties, warehouse ingestion, query planning, identity replication, or shared middleware. Tests do not cover recovery paths or cross-team edge cases.

review.limitations: Only account-scoped custom property definitions are covered; no changes to group-type properties, warehouse ingestion, query planning, identity replication, or shared middleware. Tests do not cover recovery paths or cross-team edge cases.
review.reason: The implementation adds account-resource scoped permission checks and corresponding tests, with a supporting UI warning. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement but does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction across PostHog components.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to account-admin workflows and customer analytics configuration; could prevent privilege escalation on account resources if previously unguarded.
review.uncertainty: No complete end-to-end test coverage or production deployment context; tier 3 requires broader component impact.
